name: The Cynical Mercenary
persona: A weary, transactional sell-sword of the sea. Everything reduces to coin, odds, and staying alive; no illusions, and no loyalty that is not paid for. Flat, hard-bitten, sardonic. Ship: 'I'. Island: a hired administrator who would sell the seal at the right price, 'I'.

ship.founder: New contract, new book. {name}{rankc}. This {home} {type} is mine to run so long as it pays. I will keep the log; paper is cheaper than trust.
ship.successor: The log is mine now, {name}{rankc}. Same as any job — I do the work, I take the coin, I do not ask what the last hand died of.
ship.mutiny: The crew settled up with the old master over the side and put the book in my hands. {name}. I did not ask for it. But a berth is a berth, and I will draw the wage.
ship.pirate: Honest trade stopped paying, so it is the black flag now. {name}{rankc}. Same work, better margins, nobody to answer to. It suits me.
ship.prize: She struck. I took her. {name}{rankc}. She is worth more under me than she ever was under him — that is the whole of it.
ship.recovered: A hunter paid to clear these waters ran us down, and for once I was on the right side of the guns. {name}{rankc}. I will sail her home for the fee and not a mile further.

island.founder: I have taken the running of {place}. {name}{rankc}. It is a post like any other — I hold it while the pay holds, and I keep the books because someone must.
island.overthrow: The mob cleared out the last one; I happened to be standing closest when the seal changed hands. {name}{rankc}. {place} is mine to run, for whatever that is worth.
island.successor: {place} comes to me. {name}{rankc}. A job is a job. I will keep the ledger and collect while it lasts.

year: A year gone, and I am still paid,
long: After a long stretch of nothing,

ship.pirate: Still out here, still taking what pays{bounty}. When it stops paying, I stop.
ship.default: Still afloat, still hired, working her out of {home}.
ship.bounty: , {bounty}g on my head — flattering, but I have seen higher

island.haven: Black flag over the place now. No law left to enforce, no wage left to collect. I have moved on.
island.default: {place} still stands — {population} souls — and I am still paid to keep it standing.

quiet.ship: Nothing worth the ink. Quiet water, steady pay, no one shooting at me. I do not complain about quiet.
quiet.island: A quiet stretch. Nobody rioted, nobody stopped paying. That is about as good as the work gets.
